INSERT INTO covers (track_id, album_id, blob_sha256, mime, width, height, source, position)
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7,
                (SELECT COALESCE(max(position) + 1, 0) FROM covers
                 WHERE (track_id = $8 OR album_id = $8) AND trashed_at IS NULL))
        RETURNING id
